# Lumi Trades

> Three product lines, sold per call to AI agents with x402 (USDC on Base or Stellar, or XRP, RLUSD or USDC on the XRP Ledger);
> no account or API key.
> - Lumi Trust: x402 seller checks (allow / warn / block), vendor reports, signed test-buy receipts and a free vendor trust list
>   built from real on-ledger test-buys of other pay-per-call endpoints.
> - Market data: live prices, CoinMarketCap Fear & Greed, funding, a daily market brief, events and a daily Institutional &
>   Policy Brief (BIS, IMF, CBDCs, stablecoins, tokenization).
> - Lumi Market Ideas: an AI's buy/sell signals (RSI, MACD, EMA), support and resistance levels, the all-coins scan, the
>   paper-trade slate and the trade history. Paper-trade analysis, not investment advice. Lumi does not trade real money.

## API docs (api.lumitrades.io)
- [API home](https://api.lumitrades.io/): overview, prices and the 402 flow
- [OpenAPI spec](https://api.lumitrades.io/openapi.json): every endpoint, parameter and response
- [Agent skill (skill.md)](https://api.lumitrades.io/skill.md): step-by-step guide for an agent to pay and call the API
- [x402 discovery](https://api.lumitrades.io/.well-known/x402): machine-readable list of paid resources and accepted payments
- [MCP server](https://api.lumitrades.io/mcp): remote MCP (streamable HTTP); local option `npx -y lumi-trades-mcp`
- [Trust methodology](https://api.lumitrades.io/v1/trust/methodology): how vendor trust scores are computed

## Pages
- [For AI agents](https://lumitrades.io/agents/): what the API sells, prices, how to pay, MCP setup and FAQ
- [x402 vendor trust list](https://lumitrades.io/trust/): automated quote checks and paid test-buys of x402 endpoints, with on-ledger evidence
- [How Lumi works](https://lumitrades.io/how-it-works/): how the buy/sell signals are scored, how paper-trade ideas, leverage caps and Missed-it plans are set, and the tracker's fill/stop/target rules (also in es, pt, tr, ko, ja)
- [Dashboard](https://lumitrades.io/): live prices, plus Lumi Market Ideas (signals and today's paper-trade ideas) (also in es, pt, tr, ko, ja)
- [Trade ideas](https://lumitrades.io/trades/): Lumi Market Ideas, the active paper-trade ideas (paper-trade analysis, not investment advice)

## Prices (USD per call)
### Lumi Trust
- `GET /v1/trust/check?url=`: x402 pay check: allow / warn / block with reasons, signed receipts, $0.004 per call
- `GET /v1/trust/vendors/{id}/report`: Detailed vendor report (full observation history), $0.02 per call
- `GET /v1/trust/vendors`: Vendor trust list and seller lookup, free
- `POST /v1/trust/receipts/verify`: Verify a signed test-buy receipt, free

### Market data
- `GET /v1/market`: BTC + macro market backdrop, $0.02 per call
- `GET /v1/brief`: Daily crypto market brief, $0.02 per call
- `GET /v1/macro/yen`: Yen carry-trade watch (USD/JPY, Nikkei), $0.01 per call
- `GET /v1/sentiment`: Crypto sentiment (CoinMarketCap Fear & Greed, funding), $0.005 per call
- `GET /v1/events`: Macro and crypto events calendar, $0.005 per call
- `GET /v1/funding`: Perpetual funding rates (50 coins), $0.003 per call
- `GET /v1/fear-greed`: CoinMarketCap Fear & Greed with history, $0.003 per call
- `GET /v1/events/next48h`: Events in the next 48 hours, $0.003 per call
- `GET /v1/institutional`: Daily Institutional & Policy Brief, $0.10 per call

### Lumi Market Ideas
> Paper-trade analysis, not investment advice. Lumi does not trade real money.
- `GET /v1/signal/{coin}`: Signal per coin (buy/sell read, RSI/MACD/EMA), $0.01 per call
- `GET /v1/levels/{coin}`: Support / resistance and 7-day scenario levels (not forecasts), $0.01 per call
- `GET /v1/scan`: All-coins scan (50 signals in one call), $0.02 per call
- `GET /v1/lite/{coin}`: Lite signal per coin (label, score, price), $0.004 per call
- `GET /v1/slate`: Market slate (today's paper-trade ideas), $0.02 per call
- `GET /v1/trades`: Paper-trade history, $0.02 per call

## Seller monitoring and trust data feed (x402, 30-day plans, no auto-renew)
- Monitor: $9 per 30 days. 1 endpoint: one test-buy per term (plus one recheck after a failure) and alerts
- Monitor Plus: $29 per 30 days. Up to 20 endpoints: weekly test-buys and alerts
- Audit: $99 one-time. One test-buy of every listed endpoint, with a full report signed by Lumi's wallet
- Free: $0. 1,000 lookups a month per key (wallet-signature signup), answer-only
- Feed credits: $1.50 per 1,000 lookups. Prepaid lookups on top of the free 1,000 a month; credits never expire
- Feed: $99 per 30 days. 100,000 bulk lookups, delta feed, full evidence and receipts
- Feed Pro: $199 per 30 days. 500,000 lookups, delta feed, licensed full snapshot export, status-change webhooks, receipts
- [Seller monitoring](https://api.lumitrades.io/v1/monitor) · [Trust data feed](https://api.lumitrades.io/v1/feed) · [Feed licence](https://api.lumitrades.io/v1/feed/license)
